extensions.contextHint: What Claude Code loads for this folder: user, then project, then local (the last one wins).
extensions.sessionNote: Session: Claude Code cannot be tuned mid-run; open sessions reload changes on their own, except plugins, which need /reload-plugins or a restart.
extensions.mcpManaged: Plugin servers, claude.ai connectors and `~/.claude.json` servers are not set here: use the plugin above, your claude.ai account, or `claude mcp`.
extensions.offWins: A disable in any scope wins over the others.
extensions.mcpPlugin: from a plugin: set with the plugin
extensions.mcpAccount: claude.ai account connector: set in claude.ai
extensions.whereU: For me, in all my projects
extensions.whereP: For this project (file shared with the team)
extensions.whereL: For this project, privately (on this machine)
extensions.hintUser: Each switch turns the item on or off for you, in all your projects.
extensions.hintProject: Each switch shows the real state for this project. A higher-priority setting (private, then project, then personal) wins.
extensions.pluginsHelp: Plugins add skills, hooks and MCP servers.
extensions.skillsHelp: Skills are instructions Claude launches when they apply. Their description is always in its context.
extensions.mcpHelp: MCP servers give Claude external tools (browser, database…).
